first.match: Match each athlete to the sporting first they are known for.
first.reverse: Which of these athletes earned this sporting first: {value}?

rows.label: Lewis Hamilton
rows.first: First Black Formula One world champion
rows.hook: is a British driver who now races for Ferrari and holds the record for most race victories

rows.label: Deion Sanders
rows.first: First to play in both a Super Bowl and a World Series
rows.description: American football and baseball player and football coach
rows.hook: is nicknamed Prime Time and starred in the NFL and in baseball before coaching college football

rows.label: Babe Ruth
rows.first: First to hit 60 home runs in a season
rows.hook: was nicknamed the Sultan of Swat and went from Red Sox pitcher to Yankees slugger

rows.label: Arthur Ashe
rows.first: First Black man to win the Wimbledon singles title
rows.hook: was a serve-and-volley star who also took the US Open and Australian Open crowns

rows.label: Tiger Woods
rows.first: First Black golfer to win the Masters
rows.hook: won his first major by twelve strokes and became one of the most famous athletes in the world

rows.label: Sachin Tendulkar
rows.first: First man to score a double century in a one-day international
rows.hook: is the all-time leading run-scorer in cricket and the only batsman to reach 100 hundreds

rows.label: Roberto Clemente
rows.first: First Latin American inducted into the Baseball Hall of Fame
rows.hook: was a Pirates right fielder who died in a plane crash carrying relief for earthquake survivors

rows.label: Steffi Graf
rows.first: First tennis player to win the Golden Slam
rows.hook: won 22 major singles titles and spent a record 377 weeks ranked world number one

rows.label: Pelé
rows.first: First to win three World Cups
rows.hook: was named Athlete of the Century by the International Olympic Committee

rows.label: Jackie Robinson
rows.first: First Black player in modern Major League Baseball
rows.hook: was a four-sport star at UCLA before a Brooklyn Dodgers career at first base

rows.label: Wilt Chamberlain
rows.first: First to score 100 points in an NBA game
rows.hook: was a 7-foot-1 center who set dozens of NBA records

rows.label: Danica Patrick
rows.first: First woman to win an IndyCar race
rows.hook: raced in NASCAR too and is the most successful female driver in American open-wheel history

rows.label: Wayne Gretzky
rows.first: First NHL player to score 200 points in a season
rows.description: Canadian ice hockey player and coach (born 1961)
rows.hook: is nicknamed the Great One and is the NHL's all-time leading scorer

rows.label: Lou Gehrig
rows.first: First MLB player to have his number retired
rows.hook: earned the nickname Iron Horse for his durability as a Yankees first baseman

rows.label: Tony Hawk
rows.first: First to land a 900 on a skateboard
rows.hook: is a skateboarder nicknamed Birdman whose name is on a hit video game series

rows.label: Jim Thorpe
rows.first: First Native American to win Olympic gold
rows.description: American track and field athlete and baseball player (1888-1953)
rows.hook: was stripped of his medals after it emerged he had been paid for semi-pro baseball

rows.label: Bill Russell
rows.first: First Black head coach in the NBA
rows.hook: led the Boston Celtics to eleven championships in thirteen seasons

rows.label: Eliud Kipchoge
rows.first: First to run a marathon distance in under two hours
rows.hook: is a Kenyan star, twice a champion at the Games and a former record holder

rows.label: Nadia Comăneci
rows.first: First perfect 10 in Olympic gymnastics
rows.description: Romanian gymnast and five-time Olympic gold medalist (born 1961)
rows.hook: was a teenage gymnast who won three golds at the Montreal Games

rows.label: Cathy Freeman
rows.first: First Indigenous Australian to win individual Olympic gold
rows.hook: lit the cauldron at her home Games and then took the 400 metres title there

rows.label: Johnny Weissmuller
rows.first: First to swim 100 metres freestyle in under a minute
rows.description: American swimmer, water polo player, and actor (1904–1984)

rows.label: Surya Bonaly
rows.first: First to land a backflip on one blade at the Olympics
rows.hook: won five European titles and three World silver medals in figure skating

rows.label: Gertrude Ederle
rows.first: First woman to swim the English Channel

rows.label: Roger Bannister
rows.first: First to run a mile in under four minutes
rows.hook: was a neurologist who ran at Oxford's Iffley Road track to break a famed barrier

rows.label: Althea Gibson
rows.first: First Black player to win a Grand Slam tennis title
rows.hook: took 11 major crowns across singles, doubles and mixed and later turned pro on the golf tour
